name: Ishkara Silt-Eye
source_profile:
Speaker Ishkara Silt-Eye (LE)

Ishkara is an elderly lizardfolk leader selected to represent the principal Reedholds in dealings with outsiders. She is patient, calculating, and deeply concerned with preserving the wetlands upon which her people depend. She has little objection to Cadorian commerce in principle, but strongly opposes the draining of marshes, construction of permanent embankments, and interference with seasonal flooding.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 54 (source excerpt; may be partial)
